long_biography.plain_text:
The 'My' housing concept gave Ali Ağaoğlu's property business a recognisable identity in Istanbul. Introduced around the turn of the century, the model combined large residential developments with offices, shops and shared amenities. The projects helped move Ağaoğlu Group from conventional building into branded, mixed-use property development.

Ağaoğlu broadened the group beyond housing after starting tourism investments in 1988 and entering energy in 2007. Its renewable-energy division developed wind-power projects, while the tourism arm operates hotels and sports clubs. He continues to chair group companies and also leads the board of Ağaoğlu's listed real-estate investment company.
